I personally have spent $400+ to read this book and I get 5 minutes a days worth. Good story, bad delivery. The same story with different character names is online FREE - the two chapters per day made it painful - the only saving grace was that the bonus points earned covered the cost of two chapters. Not anymore… the per “page” cost has doubled. So the two “chapters now cost 22 points each, the bonus points “earned” total 30 points. Since there is no refund - when my Points are gone so am I. Hero of Hearts … Free, Charismatic Charlie Wade … a short chapter (5 “pages” is 22 points. Not worth it… save your money.

This person that wrote the above review is 110% correct and Has stated they spent $400+ … I have spent double that ($800+). The Story is not complete and the Hero of Hearts stopped in exactly the same place. It has been a month of no releases. Breach of contract.

reviews.title: Greedy and corrupt
reviews.text: I never had high expectations for apps like these. Most of the stories are amateur dime store novels about power fantasy. Still, I wanted to give it a fair shake. After using it for a day or too, I realized it was wrong of me to hate this app for its stories. Not when there's so many better reasons to hate it. Subscriptions to a story are ten dollars a week. Ten dollars, I could understand paying for a story. Not these stories, mind, which are worth a buck if that. But in general, I could understand if it was like that. Instead, they want ten dollars a WEEK for the privilege of reading these chapters. You're supposed to be able to unlock chapters with gold, but I've checked in and jumped through some other hoops to get gold, and I'm nowhere near close to unlocking a single extra chapter. It doesn't even tell me how much the chapter is, just ushers me to the store page like it's hoping I'll pay before I ever even realize what a terrible deal this is. Finally, I learn there's one more way to earn in app: giving a review. Not just any review, though. If you want to get paid you have to give it 5 stars. This CAN'T actually be allowed by the App Store, can it? You're literally bribing people to leave positive reviews. I have a screenshot of the screen in question, and I'm pretty positive there's no misunderstanding it. This is messed up, on multiple levels. I strongly recommend finding your werewolf romance elsewhere.

The only way to get back to your book is to completely restart the phone. When it first started I thought it was the ad because it happened every time on that particular ad. I can only conclude the app is hoping I’m so far into this book that I’ll spend real money to finish the book.  They guessed wrong.

There are various ways to earn points. Hear are a few examples. A 15 point login bonus for the first day (not enough to read). If you think you can watch ads, it is 1 point per ad. You can get up to 15 points for that. You can get 50 points by writing a good review. So I doubt I will get any points for this review. A book is suppose to be relaxing, entertaining, educational or for pleasure. Not being data mined, taking up your time, and money for every page or chapter you read.

reviews.title: What a Rip Off
reviews.text: This program is designed to steel your money so not fall for it

reviews.title: What a rip-off
reviews.text:
Saw this app come up as an advertisement and got sucked into the story used in said-advertisement. The writing and plot is what I’d expect from a romance novel; very little character development, lots of emotional expressions from the characters. I think I was hoping it would fill in the void after watching the last season of Bridgerton or something, but it’s a far stretch, to say the least. Also, there’s grammatical and spelling errors, which distract me from getting lost in a story, especially one I’m having to put effort into reading due to the chores and/ or expense of “earning” coins. 

After less than a week, I’ve deleted the app. I’m over the frustration of trying to read more than 1-2 “chapters,” which include a few short paragraphs, at best, without having to either watch ads for 1 “bonus” coin, or start another story so I can earn another 5-10 bonus coins while trying to keep the story I want to read fresh in my mind. You need 35 coins to unlock another chapter; you earn 20 coins for checking in each day, but unless you’re okay with tedious, time-consuming tasks or willing to pay for coins (which are overpriced - you don’t get what you pay for imo), you’ll have to wait 24 hours to start the process all over again. 

I’ll stick with reading physical books, which I can get for free and read as much as I want for as long as I want, from the library.

reviews.title: Billionaire Match
reviews.text:
Good story but very disappointing that you can only go so far into the storyline. There are several of these types of books and short stories popping up
Constantly in facebook and they are very expensive indeed in comparison to Audible, Kindle etc and I refuse to buy to read a story that is very overpriced. This one may be ok as time goes on but in the past I have downloaded both books and short movies and have found they are poorly written with grammar and go off topic regularly clearly due to the language barrier. This one doesn’t give any information on other books either.
The short stories are all the same they just change the names and characters but it’s always about CEO and a b*st@rd child and some inheritance and it’s socially acceptable for women to be slapped and whipped by men and women in public.
